data.name: Wreck & Reef Tour
data.headline: 3-4 Hours • Ages 8+
data.description: Experience the best wreck diving in Hawaiian waters, including the Sea Tiger and YO-257 wrecks. Specialty long-range charters explore stunning sites like the Ewa Pinnacles and the Corsair WWII fighter plane. Enjoy a guided tour of these wrecks and reefs, accompanied by an in-water guide and premium gear.
data.highlights:
- Dive famous wrecks like the Sea Tiger and YO-257
- Explore ancient lava formations and vibrant coral reefs
- Spot Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles and tropical fish
data.itinerary:
- Dive 1: Explore iconic wrecks such as Sea Tiger or YO-257
- Dive 2: Visit top reef sites like Fantasy Reef
- Specialty Long-Range Charters: Ewa Pinnacles, Corsair, Navy Tug, and more
data.what_is_included:
In-Water Guide
All premium gear
Light snack with refreshments

Swimwear

data.cancellation_summary: Cancel anytime with trip protection; no refunds for changes in dive sites.
data.cancellation_notes:
#Guest Cancellations: 
Reservations canceled over the phone with at least 48-hours notice will not be charged. Email cancellations will NOT be accepted. Reservations canceled with less than 48-hour notice will be charged the full charter price unless trip insurance was purchased. All 'no-shows' will be charged the full amount of the charter. Contact us by phone at (808) 922-3483 to cancel or inquire about a cancellation.
Dive Oahu offers trip protection as we understand that emergencies and life happen. 

#Charter Alterations or Cancellations:
Dive Oahu reserves the right to alter charter details or cancel charters should it be necessary, due to adverse weather, minimum passenger requirements, or other related conditions. Dive Oahu is not responsible for expenses and/or other related costs due to altered charter details or canceled charters. Guests are responsible for providing Dive Oahu with correct contact information, to keep guests informed in the event of changes made to the charters booked. 
If the customer is only able to complete a single dive due to the need to alter the charter for adverse weather or conditions,. please note that they will receive the cost of the second dive only as a refund. Please see below for breakdown of dive costs. 

#Marine Life: 
The diverse marine life that live in the sea are affected by ocean conditions, seasonal changes, feeding trends and other uncontrollable factors. While our experienced and knowledgeable crew make all reasonable efforts to find specific ocean dwellers, no guarantees are made for their presence. We are a leave no trace company. We do not allow our customers to touch marine life including turtles. A customer who actively tries to touch ocean dwellers, will be immediately returned to the boat and the rest of the dive(s) forfeited with no refund. 

#Prices: 
All prices subject to change without notice. In the event of a single dive being cancelled by Dive Oahu  due to weather or unforeseen circumstances the first dive price is $175.00 and the second dive is $54.00. On our 3 tank dive tours our first dive price is $192.00,  the second dive is $54.00 and the third dive is $54.00. All refunds for partial dives will be calculated as listed above.
data.booking_notes:
***You can NOT fly for 24 hours after diving***
***You must be at the harbor 30 minutes prior to check in***

**Trip Protection**
Make sure what happens on land doesn't impact your underwater time! Protect yourself with trip protection so you can cancel your tour anytime and for any reason for a full refund less the cost of trip protection and fees! (90% refunded)

Looking for something extra to add on to your charter? Please give us a call at **(808) 922 - 3483** to ask our staff about the following options: 
- Private Guide
- Photographer 
- Camera Rental  *(GoPro or SeaLife Camera Housing)*

**Long Range Charters**

Please note that Dive Oahu cannot guarantee that our dive charters will visit the advertised location(s). The ability to participate at specific dive sites is contingent upon factors such as weather/water conditions, minimum passenger requirements, and/or other circumstances beyond our control. In the event of an altered charter location, Dive Oahu will not be held responsible for any expenses or related costs incurred by participants. We strive to provide an enjoyable and safe experience for all our customers, but unforeseen circumstances may necessitate changes to the planned itinerary. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this matter. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us.
